scope: Read-only privacy and project-content audit of every staged PDF and DOCX; no source artifact changed.
method: Extracted complete PDF text with pdftotext and inspected project titles/opening content.
Inspected PDF information dictionaries, XMP metadata, annotations and embedded-file/JavaScript presence with pypdf.
Inspected every DOCX XML and relationship part, core/custom properties, comment and embedded-content inventory.
Scanned extracted content and metadata for private routing, credential and contact patterns; inspected project attribution and document identity.
Recomputed every file SHA-256 after inspection to confirm no artifact mutation.
cache_policy: Exclude all __pycache__ directories and .pyc/.pyo files from the public payload. This audit does not modify them.
limits: No fresh document rebuild or whole-document visual layout review was performed in this audit.
Pattern scans and structured inspection are bounded privacy evidence, not a guarantee against arbitrary steganography.
This audit does not re-prove mathematical statements or claim third-party novelty certification.
